Both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs and trip_record.actual_distance_km may not be cited for the threshold test; here the two agree at 14.4 km in any event.

The excess is additionally MATERIAL: 60.0% of optimal exceeds the 50% material threshold and 5.4 km is below the 8.0 km absolute material threshold, so the material limb fires on the percentage test alone. That engages the driver_profile check under POL-RD-06.

Under POL-RD-13 the driver's external-traffic assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.
